summary.temporal_conclusion: Decision: authorities_verified WITH temporal warnings, not blocked_temporal_uncertainty. Evidence: (1) the canonical tree (lankalaw HTML) and the registry RGD PDF (official, sha256 363103b9...) are both the 1980 Revised Edition of the Notaries Ordinance (Cap. 110, header ends at Law 20 of 1976); every cited rule was read on the PDF page and matches the tree text (rule 2 excepted: tree scrambled). (2) The researcher believed a pre-2022 amendment was missing from the tree. Tested: the 2022 Act's quotation of rule 16(a) ('the assessment number and the name, if any, of the street') is the wording inserted by Notaries (Amendment) Act No. 47 of 2011, whose text IS in the repo (data/legal-sources/library/finalized/1-1907-notaries-ordinance/47-2011-notaries-ordinance-amendment.json, from the Government Printer PDF under amendments/incoming/); the researcher missed it, together with Act No. 13 of 2013 (s.27(3), Form D) and the Increase of Fines Act 12 of 2005. So the tree is indeed the 1980 text and omits the 2011 and 2013 changes, but neither of those touches any rule cited here. (3) The 2022 Act's other non-matching quotation (rule 30 'registered power of attorney') remains unexplained by any instrument in the repo; rule 30 is supporting only (attorney alternative) and its conflict is kept unresolved. (4) Quotations of pre-existing words in the 2022/2024 Acts for rules 9, 20(g) and 29 match the 1980 text verbatim, and neither Act mentions rules 12, 18, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 28 or s.32. (5) Prevention of Frauds s.2/s.16: tree = pre-2022 text (chain 1947 -> 2022 -> 2024 complete in the PDF header); recorded current_text_superseded_since_event; demoted to supporting. Companies Act s.19: the only Companies amendment in the registry (Act 13 of 2019, SRC032) amends s.5 -> current_text_applicable. Result: s.32(2) current_text_applicable; s.31 rules history_unknown (because the rule-30 anomaly sits in the same section) but with no instrument in the repo touching them between 1980 and October 2020; the answers to Q01/Q02 would not change on any reading the repo supports. Flagged for legal review via the validator's temporal_warnings.
